note: Quality-loop gate contracts (owner's order of 30 October 2026: implement the eight principles as a gate for all dev). The red-team gate QL-1.01 refuses signing of any contract, these included, without a clean record.

contracts.title: Red-team gate: no contract is signed without a clean record that matches its spec
contracts.closes: Closes quality-loop principle 1 (red-team each contract before signing) and the signing-time part of principle 2 (red-green primary, document-only checks never count toward done). A zero-dependency node script reads a contract spec and its red-team record and reports SIGNABLE, NOT SIGNABLE with reasons, or NO RECORD; a test proves every refusal rule; the seed-gate and the sign runbook call it
contracts.status: proposed: owner's quality-loop order of 30 Oct, signs after a clean red-team round

contracts.title: Mutation gate: the changed lines are broken on purpose and the tests must catch every mutant
contracts.closes: Closes quality-loop principle 2 (a test that survives a mutation is a weak test)
contracts.status: proposed: owner's quality-loop order of 30 Oct, signs after a clean red-team round

contracts.title: Security checklist before merge on every change that touches command execution, auth, tokens, the tunnel or the oplog
contracts.status: proposed: owner's quality-loop order of 30 Oct, signs after a clean red-team round

contracts.title: The claims check runs in every repository from one script: a claim ahead of its status row fails CI

contracts.status: proposed: owner's quality-loop order of 30 Oct, signs after a clean red-team round

contracts.title: The sensitive-path gate runs in CI from a workflow the pull request cannot change
contracts.closes: Closes quality-loop principle 7 in CI. contracts.status: proposed: owner's quality-loop order of 30 Oct, signs after a clean red-team round
